en.title: Werder Bremen plays HSV in 111th Nordderby on 22 November 2026
en.dek: Werder Bremen and HSV meet for the 111th Bundesliga-Nordderby on Sunday, 22 November 2026.
facts: Werder Bremen and HSV meet in the 111th Bundesliga-Nordderby on Sunday, 22 November 2026 (according to Kicker).
Werder Bremen has 15 points and is in sixth place in the table (according to Global Soccer Networks).
Werder Bremen has scored 17 goals this season (according to Sportschau).
Niclas Füllkrug stated 'Nee, danke, ciao' after a 0:1 loss in Stuttgart, declining questions about the national team (according to Sportschau).
body: Werder Bremen and the HSV will meet in the 111th Bundesliga-Nordderby on Sunday, 22 November 2026 (according to Kicker).
Kicker reported that the match will be available live on television and stream (according to Kicker).
Sportschau reported that Werder Bremen has 17 goals and 15 points, while the analysis noted the HSV has chances to utilize Werder Bremen's weaknesses (according to Sportschau).
Daniel Thioune, Werder Bremen's coach, stated that the team has developed since the 1:1 draw in the previous season (according to Sportschau).
en.context: The Nordderby is the rivalry between Werder Bremen and Hamburger SV, and this match is the 111th meeting in the Bundesliga (according to Kicker).
en.imageCaption: Die Trainer Daniel Thioune (l.) und Merlin Polzin begrüßen sich. | WITTERS / Leonie Horky

de.title: Werder Bremen trifft am 22. November 2026 zum 111. Nordderby auf HSV
de.dek: Werder Bremen und HSV treffen am Sonntag, den 22. November 2026, zum 111. Bundesliga-Nordderby aufeinander.
facts: Werder Bremen und HSV treffen am Sonntag, 22. November 2026, zum 111. Bundesliga-Nordderby aufeinander (laut Kicker)
Werder Bremen hat 15 Punkte und steht auf dem Tabellenplatz sechs (laut Global Soccer Networks)
Werder Bremen hat in dieser Saison 17 Tore erzielt (laut Sportschau)
Niclas Füllkrug sagte nach einer 0:1-Niederlage in Stuttgart „Nee, danke, ciao“ und lehnte Fragen zur Nationalmannschaft ab (laut Sportschau)
body: Werder Bremen und der HSV bestreiten am Sonntag, 22. November 2026 das 111. Bundesliga-Nordderby.
Kicker berichtete, dass die Partie live im Fernsehen und im Stream zu sehen sein wird.
Die Sportschau berichtete, dass Werder Bremen 17 Tore und 15 Punkte aufweist, während die Analyse die HSV-Chancen sieht, die Schwächen von Werder Bremen zu nutzen.
Daniel Thioune, Trainer von Werder Bremen, erklärte, dass sich die Mannschaft seit dem 1:1-Unentschieden in der Vorsaison entwickelt habe.
de.context: Das Nordderby ist die Rivalität zwischen Werder Bremen und Hamburger SV, und dieses Spiel ist das 111. Aufeinandertreffen in der Bundesliga (laut Kicker).
de.imageCaption: Die Trainer Daniel Thioune (l.) und Merlin Polzin begrüßen sich. | WITTERS / Leonie Horky

es.title: Werder Bremen se enfrenta al HSV en el 111º Nordderby el 22 de noviembre de 2026
es.dek: Werder Bremen y HSV se medirán en el 111º Bundesliga-Nordderby el domingo 22 de noviembre de 2026.
facts: Werder Bremen y HSV se enfrentan en el 111º Bundesliga-Nordderby el domingo 22 de noviembre de 2026 (según Kicker)
Werder Bremen tiene 15 puntos y ocupa la sexta posición en la tabla (según Global Soccer Networks)
Werder Bremen ha marcado 17 goles esta temporada (según Sportschau)
Niclas Füllkrug declaró 'No, gracias, ciao' tras una derrota 0-1 en Stuttgart, rechazando preguntas sobre la selección nacional (según Sportschau)
body: Werder Bremen y el HSV se enfrentarán en el 111º Nordderby de la Bundesliga el domingo 22 de noviembre de 2026 (según Kicker).
Kicker informó que el partido estará disponible en televisión en directo y en *streaming* (según Kicker).
Sportschau comunicó que Werder Bremen cuenta con 17 goles y 15 puntos, mientras que el análisis señaló que el HSV tiene posibilidades de explotar las debilidades de Werder Bremen (según Sportschau).
Daniel Thioune, entrenador de Werder Bremen, declaró que el equipo ha mejorado desde el empate 1-1 de la temporada anterior (según Sportschau).
es.context: El Nordderby es el derbi entre Werder Bremen y Hamburger SV, y este partido es el 111º encuentro en la Bundesliga (según Kicker).
es.imageCaption: Los entrenadores Daniel Thioune (izquierda) y Merlin Polzin se saludan. | WITTERS / Leonie Horky

pt.title: Werder Bremen enfrenta o HSV no 111º Nordderby a 22 de novembro de 2026
pt.dek: Werder Bremen e HSV enfrentam-se no 111º Nordderby da Bundesliga no domingo, 22 de novembro de 2026.
facts: Werder Bremen e HSV enfrentam-se no 111º Nordderby da Bundesliga no domingo, 22 de novembro de 2026 (segundo Kicker)
Werder Bremen tem 15 pontos e está em sexto lugar na tabela (segundo Global Soccer Networks)
Werder Bremen marcou 17 golos nesta época (segundo Sportschau)
Niclas Füllkrug declarou 'Não, obrigado, tchau' após uma derrota por 0:1 em Stuttgart, recusando perguntas sobre a seleção nacional (segundo Sportschau)
body: Werder Bremen e o HSV vão encontrar-se no 111.º Nordderby da Bundesliga no domingo, 22 de novembro de 2026 (segundo o Kicker).
O Kicker reportou que o jogo estará disponível ao vivo na televisão e em streaming (segundo o Kicker).
O Sportschau reportou que o Werder Bremen tem 17 golos e 15 pontos, enquanto a análise apontou hipóteses para o HSV aproveitar as fraquezas do Werder Bremen (segundo o Sportschau).
Daniel Thioune, treinador do Werder Bremen, afirmou que o equipamento tem desenvolvido-se desde o empate a 1:1 da época anterior (segundo o Sportschau).
pt.context: O Nordderby é o dérbi entre Werder Bremen e Hamburger SV, e este jogo é o 111º encontro na Bundesliga (segundo Kicker).
pt.imageCaption: Os treinadores Daniel Thioune (esquerda) e Merlin Polzin cumprimentam-se. | WITTERS / Leonie Horky

zh.title: 维德尔不莱梅对阵汉堡体育 争夺第111次北德 derby
zh.dek: 维德尔不莱梅与汉堡体育将于2026年11月22日星期日争夺第111次 Bundesliga 北德 derby
facts: 维德尔不莱梅与汉堡体育将于2026年11月22日星期日争夺第111次 Bundesliga 北德 derby
维德尔不莱梅积15分位列积分榜第六位
维德尔不莱梅本赛季已进17球
尼克拉斯·菲尔克鲁格在斯图加特0:1失利后拒绝回答国家队问题，表示“Nee, danke, ciao”
body: 维德尔和汉堡将于2026年11月22日星期日交锋，争夺第111次北德 derby（根据《踢球者》报道）。
《踢球者》报道称，该场比赛将在电视和网络平台现场直播（根据《踢球者》报道）。
《体育画报》报道，维德尔进攻端有17粒进球且积15分，分析指出汉堡有机会利用维德尔的弱点（根据《体育画报》报道）。
维德尔主教练丹尼尔·蒂奥内表示，球队自上赛季1:1战平以来已有所进步（根据《体育画报》报道）。
zh.context: 北德 derby 是不莱梅与汉堡之间的 rivalry，本场比赛为 Bundesliga 第111次交锋
zh.imageCaption: 教练丹尼尔·蒂奥内（左）和梅林·波尔津相互问候。 | WITTERS / Leonie Horky

ko.title: Werder Bremen과 HSV가 111번째 북더비 맞대결 펼친다
ko.dek: Werder Bremen과 HSV가 일요일인 2026년 11월 22일에 111번째 Bundesliga-북더비를 치른다
facts: Werder Bremen과 HSV가 Kicker에 따르면 2026년 11월 22일 일요일에 111번째 Bundesliga-북더비 맞대결을 갖는다
Werder Bremen은 Global Soccer Networks에 따르면 15점으로 리그 6위에 올라 있다
Werder Bremen은 Sportschau에 따르면 이번 시즌 17골을 기록했다
Sportschau에 따르면 Niclas Füllkrug는 스투트가르트전에서 0:1 패배 후 국가대표팀 질문들에 "아니요, 감사합니다, 안녕히 계세요"라고 거절했다
body: 베르더 브레멘과 HSV가 2026년 11월 22일 일요일에 제111회 분데스리가 북더비에서 맞붙는다(키커 보도).
키커에 따르면 이 경기는 TV 생중계 및 스트리밍으로 시청 가능하다.
스포츠샤우에 따르면 베르더 브레멘은 17골과 15점을 기록했으며, 분석에 의하면 HSV는 베르더 브레멘의 약점을 공략할 기회가 있다(스포츠샤우).
베르더 브레멘의 코치 다니엘 티우네는 팀이 지난 시즌 1대1 무승부 이후 발전했다고 밝혔다(스포츠샤우).
ko.context: 북더비는 Werder Bremen과 Hamburger SV의 라이벌전이며, 이번 경기는 Kicker에 따르면 Bundesliga에서 111번째 맞대결이다
ko.imageCaption: Daniel Thioune(왼쪽) 감독과 Merlin Polzin 감독이 인사를 나누는 모습. | WITTERS / Leonie Horky

problemsFixed: The draft incorrectly attributes Daniel Thioune's comments; he is the coach of Werder Bremen, not HSV.
The draft presents analysis from Sportschau as fact without proper attribution.
The draft uses loaded language ('firmly established', 'favourites') without direct sourcing or attribution.
The draft incorrectly states the date in the body (S1 mentions Sunday, S2 mentions 22.11.2026, but the draft needs to confirm the specific Sunday).
The draft does not adhere to sentence rhythm requirements (varying length, avoiding four short declarative sentences in a row).
The draft includes filler/evaluative framing (e.g., 'The analysis notes...').
